title: Detailed telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tripod legs -->
  <polygon points='47,62 40,96 44,96 50,62' fill='#b5651d'/>

  <rect x='25' y='30' width='50' height='14' rx='7' fill='#d4af37'/>
  <rect x='25' y='34' width='50' height='6' rx='3' fill='#f0d060'/>

  <rect x='32' y='29' width='4' height='16' rx='1' fill='#a08020'/>

  <rect x='40' y='18' width='24' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c0a030'/>

  <rect x='48' y='24' width='8' height='6' rx='1' fill='#8b6b1a'/>

  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#e0c050'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#e0c050'/>
  <!-- Star twinkle near objective -->
  <polygon points='12,20 13.5,23 17,23.5 14.5,26 15,29.5 12,28 9,29.5 9.5,26 7,23.5 10.5,23' fill='#ffffaa'/>
  <polygon points='86,15 87,17 89,17.5 87.5,19 88,21 86,20 84,21 84.5,19 83,17.5 85,17' fill='#ffffaa'/>
